rules.rule: Use finite, contiguous track-relative time and valid MIDI/cents values.
Strict-mode source objects must match an approved transposition-relative family; unlisted families require review.
Conditional families must be enabled in the selected profile; low semitone requires the low-beating profile.
Reject offsets beyond 50 cents in a named-note representation; flag unintended common-tone retuning.
Use 1–6 separately represented source voices within MIDI 28–90; no duplicate MIDI entries masquerading as new notes.
Exclude three or more adjacent chromatic source voices below C3; spectral distortion products are not source voices.
Validate declared retained objects, common tones and parallel semitone moves; flag complete replacement otherwise.
Default protocol excludes declared dominant-to-tonic or repeating ii–V–I cadential plans; no automatic audio cadence recognition claimed.
Flag changed harmonic states shorter than 8 seconds; this is not a constraint on grains or individual note attacks.
